In this video, we’re going to explain Taiwan’s massive defence spending hike; its ‘porcupine’ or ‘hellscape’ plan to deter or defend against China; and why it’s proving particularly difficult.

📰 Too Long: https://toolong.news/
🎉 TLDR Party:  https://toolong.news/pages/tldr-party
📖 Read our Manifesto: https://tldrnews.co.uk/manifesto

Our mission is to explain news and politics in an impartial, efficient, and accessible way, balancing import and interest while fostering independent thought.

TLDR is a completely independent & privately owned media company that's not afraid to tackle the issues we think are most important. The channel is run by a small group of young people, with us hoping to pass on our enthusiasm for politics to other young people. We are primarily fan sourced with most of our funding coming from donations and ad revenue. No shady corporations, no one telling us what to say. We can't wait to grow further and help more people get informed. Help support us by subscribing, engaging and sharing. Thanks!

Sources:

Taiwan’s ‘hellscape’ strategy:
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/09/world/asia/taiwan-drone-china-invasion.html 
https://warontherocks.com/hellscape-taiwan-a-porcupine-defense-in-the-drone-age/ 

Proposed $40bn special defence budget:
https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/IF12481 

Legislature passed smaller special defence budget:
https://dominotheory.com/taiwans-legislature-passes-reduced-special-defense-budget/ 

2026 general budget approved after record delay:
https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202608140026 

Status of various budgetary proposals:
https://understandingwar.org/research/china-taiwan/china-taiwan-update-september-1-2026/ 

Government’s proposed $6.6bn drone budget:
https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/taiwan-tensions/taiwan-opposition-blocks-lai-s-special-drone-budget-passes-alternative 
https://thediplomat.com/2026/09/taiwan-finally-passed-its-2026-budget-what-got-cut/
https://www.wsj.com/world/asia/taiwan-prepares-a-7-billion-boost-to-drone-builders-to-counter-china-5c91ac2e
https://understandingwar.org/research/china-taiwan/china-taiwan-update-september-1-2026/ 

Taiwan’s domestic drone industry booming:
https://resiliencemedia.co/taiwans-drone-industry-is-booming-thanks-to-us-and-european-exports/
https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202609020029 

Why passed drone budget might undermine drone industry:
https://www.aspistrategist.org.au/taiwans-parliament-finally-passes-drone-bill-to-back-hedgehog-strategy/ 

Proposed 2027 budget:
https://www.reuters.com/world/china/taiwan-president-says-record-defence-spending-is-investment-peace-2026-08-17/ 

Gaps in civil defence:
https://thediplomat.com/2026/08/taiwans-missing-deterrent/
https://www.stimson.org/2025/taiwans-squandered-defensive-potential/
https://thediplomat.com/2025/08/taiwans-civil-society-is-not-ready-for-war/
https://taiwaninsight.org/2026/05/26/what-taiwans-resilience-planning-is-missing/ 

Military manpower/morale crises:
https://monocle.com/affairs/defence/taiwan-military-recruitment-china-threat/
https://asiatimes.com/2025/02/the-depths-of-taiwans-military-morale-crisis/
https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3359352/can-taiwan-fix-its-military-manpower-shortage-training-reservists-advanced-weapons
